annotations.title: Run the Keyword Strategy Builder pipeline

description: Keyword Strategy Builder: a volume -> cluster -> page -> brief pipeline over 1-500 pasted keywords, composed entirely from existing pieces — the same bulk keyword lookup, the same shared-phrase clustering engine the saved-keyword Topic Clusters feature and get_topic_research both already use, a text-match against the project's own crawled pages, and a BOUNDED number of AI-gateway content-brief calls (one per cluster among the top few by measured volume, gated by the shared AI-gateway budget). `page.status: "existing"` on a cluster means the site already has a page ABOUT that topic (title/URL text-match), never a verified ranking claim — this codebase has no keyword-to-URL index. A cluster beyond the brief limit gets `brief: null, briefSkipped: true` — an honest 'not attempted', not an empty brief. Consumes the SAME keyword_lookups_per_day plan quota bulk lookups do (once per request) plus up to a handful of AI-gateway operations.

keywords.description: 1-500 keywords to analyze (e.g. from a bulk research run or an export).

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Omit it to use the project's default market language, which falls back to 'en'.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Omit it to use the project's default market, which falls back to 2840 (United States) for a project that has not set one. See dataforseo.com/help-center/locations. Some countries (e.g. Iceland, 2352) are served from Google Ads data: keyword volume/CPC/trends work, but keyword difficulty, search intent, and domain analytics are unavailable.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_keyword_strategy
